notice: Subset of the C2SP Wycheproof ML-DSA-65 verify vectors (Apache-2.0, https://github.com/C2SP/wycheproof). Only tests with result 'invalid' for a malformed hint encoding (InvalidHintsEncoding) or an infinity-norm violation (InfinityNormViolation) are kept. Fields are unpadded base64url of the raw bytes in the source file; the message and key are those of the source test, not Apostille's.
